issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-9d740f26 (sub-split s2 of 5, claimant-owned credential fence). s1 fences the lifecycle mutations; s3 fences attempt resolve; s4 covers unclaimed passthrough and historical leases; s5 lands the whole fence. The override child (beadrs-dc8df464) and the concurrency regression child (beadrs-eec200d1) are later children of beadrs-8c343a7c and are OUT of scope here.

Scope:
- Require the exact current claim-epoch credential for resource-lock add and resource-lock remove while the issue is claimed, leased or not.
- Missing and stale credentials conflict with exit code 4 and change nothing: no lock written or removed, no revision bump, no event.
- Credential validation, the lock change, and any audit event share one IMMEDIATE transaction.
- The current claimant with the exact current credential can add and remove locks as before.

Acceptance:
- Resource-lock add and remove on a claimed issue without a credential each exit 4 with the lock set and revision unchanged on re-read.
- The same operations with a stale credential exit 4 and leave the current claim and its locks intact.
- The exact current credential succeeds for both operations.
- Regression coverage sits with the existing resource-lock tests (tests/r031_resource_locks.rs) and runs in the default suite.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.title: Gate resource-lock add and remove on the exact claim-epoch credential
